Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who We Are
 We drive innovation – from advisory and implementation to managed services and beyond, powered by a global team of over 18,500 experts representing over 90 nations in more than 30 countries. With SAP at our core and a powerful ecosystem of partners like Microsoft and ServiceNow, we continuously improve solutions and AI-driven technology to make them work for companies – and for their people.
As part of NTT DATA, a $30+ billion business and technology services, AI and digital infrastructure leader, we are connected to a truly global organization. As a Global Top Employer, NTT DATA serves 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and, with experts in over 70 countries, co-innovates solutions that encourage experimentation and recognize great work.
With us, you have endless opportunities to think big, act bold and take ownership. Make this the place where you belong, learn and build your network.
Large-scale SAP S/4HANA Cloud rollout program , covering complex integrations between SAP S/4HANA and SAP/non-SAP applications across an international environment.
 What You Will Be Doing
Design, develop and maintain integrations using SAP Integration Suite / Cloud Integration (CPI).
Develop complex iFlows for SAP-to-SAP and SAP-to-non-SAP integration scenarios.
Build and maintain integrations with SAP S/4HANA Cloud as part of a large-scale rollout program.
Implement interfaces using REST, SOAP, OData, IDoc, SFTP and standard SAP Integration Suite adapters.
Develop message mappings, transformations, routing, exception handling and Groovy scripts.
Implement authentication and security mechanisms including OAuth 2.0 and certificate-based authentication.
Support interface design, integration testing, deployment, cutover and post-go-live stabilization.
Monitor and troubleshoot integration flows and resolve complex interface issues.
Collaborate with functional, application and architecture teams across multiple rollout streams.
Ensure integrations follow defined development standards, reusable patterns and integration best practices.
 What You Bring Along
Bachelor’s / Master’s degree preferably in Engineering or Computer Science, Business Administration from an accredited university.
Strong senior-level hands-on experience with SAP Integration Suite / SAP CPI.
Proven experience developing complex iFlows.
Strong integration experience with SAP S/4HANA / S/4HANA Cloud.
Experience working within large SAP implementation or rollout programs.
Strong knowledge of REST, SOAP, OData, IDoc, XML, JSON and SFTP.
Strong Groovy scripting, mapping and transformation skills.
Experience with error handling, monitoring and troubleshooting.
Good understanding of integration security and authentication.
Ability to work independently in a complex international delivery environment.
Nice to have: SAP API Management, SAP Event Mesh, SAP BTP, SAP Cloud Connector, SAP PI/PO to Integration Suite migration experience, CI/CD for Integration Suite EDI experience.
You are fluent in written and spoken English.
